_comment: Curated inputs for scripts/gen-acknowledgements.py. Everything else is read from what ships (editor bundle source maps, Package.resolved, theme-*.json). Add an entry here only when a source's own files are not enough, and say why in `note`.

khroma.note: package.json has no licence field; the shipped licence file is the MIT text.

@mathjax/mathjax-stix2-font.note: MathJax declares Apache-2.0 for this package (its conversion code) but ships no licence file, so the Apache-2.0 text of @mathjax/src (same project) is shown. The copyright line is the one in the package's own font definition (def/mathjax-stix2.ts). The glyph data inside the package are the STIX Two fonts, converted by MathJax, and stay under the SIL Open Font License 1.1: see the "STIX Two fonts" entry (docs/decisions.md, LIC-R34).
